name: Disable All Comments
author: seosbg

sections.description:
Disable All Comments gives you full control over comments in WordPress. Switch them off everywhere with a single master switch, or choose exactly which post types, screens and features to disable. Keeping comments? Use the built-in anti-spam and form options instead.

Made by SEOS Themes – high quality, HTML5, responsive and mobile friendly WordPress themes.

One-click master switch

  • Disable ALL comments, pingbacks and trackbacks on the whole site

Classic options (from version 1.x)

  • Hide all comments
  • Disable support for comments and trackbacks in post types
  • Disable comments on attachments
  • Close comments on the front-end
  • Hide existing comments
  • Remove the Comments page from the admin menu
  • Remove comments from pages / posts
  • Redirect users who try to open the Comments page
  • Remove the Recent Comments dashboard box
  • Remove comment links from the admin bar

New in 2.0

  • Disable comments per post type (posts, pages, media, WooCommerce products, any custom post type)
  • Automatically close comments on posts older than X days
  • Remove the comments section from themes (“Comments are closed” text disappears) – also in block themes
  • Custom message instead of the comments section
  • Extended CSS hiding of all comment areas
  • Hide comment counts and “Leave a comment” links
  • Remove comment-reply.js
  • Disable Gravatars / avatars
  • Remove links from comment author names
  • Remove Settings → Discussion page
  • Remove comment columns, Discussion meta boxes, Recent Comments widget
  • Remove all comment blocks from the block editor (Gutenberg)
  • Option to keep comment screens for administrators
  • Disable the comments REST API endpoints
  • Disable comment RSS feeds
  • Disable comment and pingback methods in XML-RPC
  • Disable pingbacks/trackbacks, self-pingbacks, X-Pingback header
  • Invisible honeypot anti-spam
  • Only logged-in users can comment
  • Minimum / maximum comment length
  • No clickable links and no HTML in comments
  • Remove the Website and cookies fields from the comment form
  • Custom form title, submit button text and comment policy note
  • Tools: close/open comments on all existing posts, delete spam/pending/trash/pingbacks/all comments
  • Export / import / reset settings
  • Comment statistics
sections.installation:
Install via Plugins > Add New

  1. Search for “Disable All Comments”
  2. Click “Install Now”
  3. Click “Activate”

Via ZIP / FTP

  1. Unzip the ZIP file and drop the folder straight into your wp-content/plugins directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Disable All Comments in the admin menu.
sections.faq:
I’m updating from 1.x. Will I lose my settings?

No. All 11 original options are stored exactly as before and keep working. Every new option is turned off by default, so your site behaves exactly the same until you enable something new.

Does deactivating the plugin bring comments back?

Yes, except for the “Close comments on all selected” tool, which changes the saved comment status of your posts in the database. Use “Open comments on all selected” to revert it.

Is there a tutorial?

See the Tutorial.

Where can I find WordPress themes from the same author?

Visit seosthemes.com.

2.0.0

  • New: completely redesigned settings page with tabs, toggle switches and statistics
  • New: master switch – disable all comments everywhere with one click
  • New: disable comments per post type and auto-close on old posts
  • New: front-end options – remove comments template, custom message, hide counts, remove comment-reply.js, disable avatars, remove author links
  • New: admin options – remove Discussion page, columns, meta boxes, widget, Gutenberg comment blocks, admin bar items, exception for administrators
  • New: REST API, RSS feeds, XML-RPC, pingback and trackback protection
  • New: comment form and anti-spam options – honeypot, logged-in only, min/max length, no links, no HTML, remove Website/cookies fields, custom texts
  • New: tools – bulk close/open comments, delete comments by type, export/import/reset settings
  • New: Premium Themes tab with the 16 newest themes from seosthemes.com
  • New: Bulgarian translation
  • Fix: the dashboard Recent Comments box is now really removed
  • Fix: admin bar comments item is removed reliably
  • Fix: translations load correctly
  • Improved: uses the manage_options capability, security nonces and escaping everywhere
  • All settings from 1.x are preserved

1.0

  • Initial release of plugin
